Messages.Author: Eino Partanen
Messages.Body:
Sorry, I'm not a regular subscriber of this newsgroup but like to
browse through it every now and then and thus I don't know if this is
a stupid question or not, but a thing rose up in our group about this
card...

The card says: "Only usable at close range before strikes are chosen.
During strike resolution, the opposing minion takes an amount of
damage etc. etc."

So, does this mean blood of acid works:

a) for the first strikes in combat and the card has no effect on
additional strikes that round

or

b) for all strikes that round

or

c) for all strikes in that combat?

or

d) something else?

Any help would be really appreciated!

Totally lost,
Eino

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Eino Partanen wrote:
> [Blood of Acid] says: "Only usable at close range before strikes are chosen.

> During strike resolution, the opposing minion takes an amount of
> damage etc. etc."
>
> So, does this mean blood of acid works:

> b) for all strikes that round

b) is correct - combat cards affect the current round by default.
